# Siap Nyafe POS > Coffee shop management platform, customer self-ordering portal, and kitchen display system. Siap Nyafe is a coffee shop point-of-sale (POS) and management web application built with React 18, Vite 5, and React Router. It features a customer self-ordering menu, cashier checkout with change calculation, kitchen display system (KDS) order tracking, ingredient inventory monitoring, staff shift scheduling, and manager financial analytics. [![Live Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-siapnyafe.widifirmaan.web.id-10B981?style=flat-square&logo=cloudflare&logoColor=white)](https://siapnyafe.widifirmaan.web.id) [![React 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-18.2.0-61DAFB?style=flat-square&logo=react&logoColor=black)](https://react.dev/) [![Vite 5](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-5.0.0-646CFF?style=flat-square&logo=vite&logoColor=white)](https://vitejs.dev/) [![React Router](https://img.shields.io/badge/Router-v6.18-CA4245?style=flat-square&logo=reactrouter&logoColor=white)](https://reactrouter.com/) [![Lucide Icons](https://img.shields.io/badge/Icons-Lucide_React-F56565?style=flat-square)](https://lucide.dev/) [![Design System](https://img.shields.io/badge/Design-Neo--Brutalism-FCD34D?style=flat-square)](#features) --- ## Live Production - **URL:** [https://siapnyafe.widifirmaan.web.id](https://siapnyafe.widifirmaan.web.id) - **Deployment:** Cloudflare Pages / Custom Domain CDN (`CNAME: siapnyafe.widifirmaan.web.id`) --- ## Showcase | Desktop Interface (MacBook Pro M4) | Mobile Interface (iPhone 16 Pro) | | :---: | :---: | | **Customer Self-Order Menu & Cart Desktop**

Portal (`/order`)**: Digital guest menu with multi-category filtering (Coffee, Non-Coffee, Pastries, Main Course), drink customization modals (sweetness, ice levels, milk alternatives), and live cart management. - **Cashier POS Register (`/cashier`)**: Order checkout terminal calculating subtotal, configurable tax percentages, coupon discounts, cash tendered exchange, and receipt printing. - **Manager Operations Dashboard (`/dashboard`)**: Sales overview tracking daily revenue, profit margins, top-selling items, and active order counts. - **Barista Kitchen Display System (`/kitchen`)**: Real-time barista ticket queue with order timestamps, preparation checklists, and progressive order lifecycle status toggling (Pending, Brewing, Completed). - **Ingredient & Stock Inventory Control (`/inventory`)**: SKU-level stock level monitoring for coffee beans, dairy, syrups, and packaging with low-stock warnings. - **Staff Roster & Weekly Shift Matrix (`/employee`, `/shift`)**: Multi-tier employee management tracking wage structures, contact information, role permissions, and weekly shift scheduling. - **Table Waiter Assistance Dispatcher (`/waiter`)**: Real-time table calling system and service request notification dispatcher for floor staff. - **Asset Depreciation & Equipment Logs (`/asset-management`)**: Maintenance tracking and depreciation calculations for espresso machines, commercial grinders, and cafe hardware. - **Financial Accounting & Ledger (`/finance`)**: Operational cost ledger, expense breakdown, and daily cash reconciliations. - **Customer Feedback & Rating Portal (`/feedback`)**: Guest review collection interface capturing satisfaction scores and customer experience sentiment. - **Promotional CMS & Announcements (`/cms`, `/post-management`)**: Content management system for cafe announcements, blog posts, and seasonal promotional banners. - **High-Contrast Component System**: Custom UI styled with CSS variables, borders, card shadows, and Lucide React vector icons. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technologies | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Core Framework** | React `18.2.0`, Vite `5.0.0` | SPA frontend foundation with fast Vite HMR and production bundle optimization | | **Routing** | React Router DOM `6.18.0` | Client-side routing, URL parameter binding, and protected route wrappers | | **State & Networking** | React Context API, Axios `1.6.0` | Centralized authentication state with global HTTP request interceptors | | **Carousels & Sliders** | Swiper `11.0.5` | Mobile touch swipe carousels for promotional menu highlights | | **Iconography** | Lucide React `0.292.0` | Consistent vector line icons across POS registers and dashboard views | --- ## Project Structure ```bash / ├── src/ │ ├── components/ │ │ ├── layout/ # Navbar, OrderPageHeader, OrderPageFooter │ │ └── ui/ # Reusable buttons, cards, modals, tables, badges │ ├── context/ │ │ └── AuthContext.jsx # Global user authentication & role state │ ├── pages/ │ │ ├── OrderPage.jsx # Customer self-ordering digital menu │ │ ├── DashboardPage.jsx # Manager operations dashboard │ │ ├── CashierPage.jsx # POS register checkout │ │ ├── KitchenPage.jsx # Kitchen Display System (KDS) │ │ ├── InventoryPage.jsx # Raw ingredient stock tracking │ │ ├── EmployeePage.jsx # Staff directory & roles │ │ ├── ShiftPage.jsx # Weekly shift scheduling │ │ ├── WaiterPage.jsx # Table waiter assistance calls │ │ ├── AssetManagementPage.jsx # Coffee machinery & depreciation │ │ ├── FinancePage.jsx # Financial ledger & expense tracking │ │ ├── FeedbackPage.jsx # Customer feedback & reviews │ │ ├── CMSPage.jsx # Public promotional landing │ │ ├── PostManagementPage.jsx # Blog & announcement manager │ │ ├── SettingsPage.jsx # Store configuration & tax settings │ │ └── LoginPage.jsx # Auth gate │ ├── utils/ # Staff and business logic helper algorithms │ ├── App.jsx # Route definitions and layouts │ └── main.jsx # React application root ├── screenshots/ # MacBook Pro M4 & iPhone 16 Pro showcase mockups └── README.md ``` --- ## Getting Started & Local Development ### Prerequisites - **Node.js**: Version 18.0.0 or higher - **npm** or **yarn** ### Installation & Setup > **Environment Variables:** No external API keys are required for local frontend development. Default demo staff credentials and menu data are pre-configured for local evaluation. ```bash # 1. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-coffee-shop-management.git cd reactjs-coffee-shop-management # 2. Install project dependencies npm install # 3. Start local development server npm run dev ``` Open [http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173) in your web browser. ### Production Build ```bash # Compile and optimize production distribution bundle npm run build ``` --- ## Author Developed by **[Widi Firmansyah](https://widifirmaan.web.id)**.

# AirPro > Modern React 19 product showcase template featuring 3D scroll-driven GSAP Scrub animation and Apple-inspired design. AirPro is a responsive React template designed for interactive product launches, high-end consumer hardware showcases, and creative audio landing experiences. Built with React 19, GSAP ScrollTrigger, and Tailwind CSS v4, it synchronizes high-definition product visual assets with user scroll gestures across an extended 3000% scrub track (3100vh)—transitioning seamlessly through an ambient video hero stage, 3D perspective dual earbud separation with dynamic typography, Active Noise Cancellation callouts, Personalized Spatial Audio showcases, an H2 processor architecture narrative, interactive hardware telemetry stat cards, and an embedded 16:9 demonstration video. [![Live Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-airpro--smooth--react--template.vercel.app-10B981?style=flat-square&logo=vercel&logoColor=white)](https://airpro-smooth-react-template.vercel.app) [![React 19](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19.0.0-61DAFB?style=flat-square&logo=react&logoColor=black)](https://react.dev/) [![GSAP 3](https://img.shields.io/badge/GSAP-3.14.2-88CE02?style=flat-square&logo=greensock&logoColor=white)](https://gsap.com/) [![Vite 6](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-6.2.0-646CFF?style=flat-square&logo=vite&logoColor=white)](https://vitejs.dev/) [![Tailwind CSS 4](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind-v4.1-38BDF8?style=flat-square&logo=tailwindcss&logoColor=white)](https://tailwindcss.com/) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.8.2-3178C6?style=flat-square&logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) --- ## Live Production - **URL:** [https://airpro-smooth-react-template.vercel.app](https://airpro-smooth-react-template.vercel.app) - **Deployment:** Vercel (Edge Network with Global CDN Caching) --- ## Showcase | Desktop | Mobile | | :---: | :---: | | **Hero Stage Presentation Desktop**
![AirPro Hero Stage Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Hero%20Stage%20Desktop.png) | **Hero Stage Presentation Mobile**
![AirPro Hero Stage Mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Hero%20Stage%20Mobile.png) | | **Dual Floating Earbuds Scroll Stage Desktop**
![AirPro Dual Earbuds Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Dual%20Earbuds%20Desktop.png) | **Dual Floating Earbuds Scroll Stage Mobile**
![AirPro Dual Earbuds Mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Dual%20Earbuds%20Mobile.png) | | **Active Noise Cancellation Stage Desktop**
![AirPro Active Noise Cancellation Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Active%20Noise%20Cancellation%20Desktop.png) | **Active Noise Cancellation Stage Mobile**
![AirPro Active Noise Cancellation Mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Active%20Noise%20Cancellation%20Mobile.png) | | **Personalized Spatial Audio Stage Desktop**
![AirPro Spatial Audio Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Spatial%20Audio%20Desktop.png) | **Personalized Spatial Audio Stage Mobile**
![AirPro Spatial Audio Mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Spatial%20Audio%20Mobile.png) | | **Hardware Telemetry & Battery Specs Desktop**
![AirPro Battery Specs Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Battery%20%26%20Specifications%20Desktop.png) | **Hardware Telemetry & Battery Specs Mobile**
![AirPro Battery Specs Mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template/main/screenshots/AirPro%20Battery%20%26%20Specifications%20Mobile.png) | --- ## Features - **3000% Scroll Scrub Track**: 3100vh sticky viewport canvas binding scroll progress directly to a master GSAP timeline (`useGSAP`) with cinematic dampened scrub sensitivity (`scrub: 2`). - **3D Perspective Dual Earbud Separation**: Coordinated translation vectors splitting left and right acoustic units along 3D depth axes (`[perspective:1000px]`, `splitX = 100%` on desktop, `30%` on mobile) accompanied by bold `PURE SOUND` typographic scaling. - **Active Noise Cancellation Showcase**: Scroll-triggered angled earbud rotation with high-contrast callout highlighting up to 2x reduction in ambient background noise. - **Personalized Spatial Audio Showcase**: Dynamic repositioning transition highlighting personalized sound calibration tuned specifically for individual ear acoustics. - **H2 Audio Processor Architecture**: Dedicated dark section with ambient blue radial glow, glassmorphic image card with hover zoom, and technical narrative detailing custom amplifier and driver synergy. - **Hardware Telemetry Stat Cards**: Responsive grid of 4 glassmorphic metric cards (`6 hrs Battery Life`, `30 hrs With Case`, `IPX4 Water Resistant`, `5.3 Bluetooth`) featuring hover elevation and cyan accent transitions. - **Liquid Glass Floating Navbar**: Responsive floating pill navigation bar (`backdrop-blur-2xl`, `bg-white/5`) with desktop link anchors (`Overview`, `Tech Specs`, `Compare`), CTA button, and mobile slide-down drawer with Lucide icon toggles and body scroll locking. - **Background Video Atmosphere**: Continuous ambient video loop layer (`/background-video.mp4`) with Gaussian blur and dark radial gradient overlay for high-end cinematic depth. - **Embedded 16:9 Demonstration Video**: Responsive aspect-ratio glassmorphic player embedding official product demonstration video from YouTube with automated autoplay, mute, and loop controls. - **Interactive Global Preloader**: Screen-blocking caching gate with spinner animation ensuring media and 3D assets are fully loaded before revealing the stage. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technologies | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Core Framework** | React `19.0.0`, Vite `6.2.0` | Frontend foundation with fast Vite HMR and production bundle optimization | | **Scroll & Timeline** | GSAP `3.14.2`, ScrollTrigger, `@gsap/react` `2.1.2` | Hardware-accelerated 3D scroll-scrub timeline and element choreography | | **Styling & Theme** | Tailwind CSS `4.1.14` (`@tailwindcss/vite`) | Utility-first styling with modern `@theme` design tokens | | **Type System** | TypeScript `5.8.2` | Type-safe components, DOM refs, and GSAP timeline parameters | | **Iconography** | Lucide React `0.546.0` | Vector line icons for navigation toggles and audio controls | | **Utility Helpers** | `clsx 2.1.1`, `tailwind-merge 3.5.0` | Conditional CSS class concatenation and conflicting utility resolution | --- ## Project Structure ```bash / ├── src/ │ ├── App.tsx # Master scroll canvas, GSAP timeline, and sections │ ├── main.tsx # React 19 application root entry point │ ├── index.css # Tailwind 4 directives and liquid glass styles │ └── lib/ │ └── utils.ts # Classname concatenation helper (cn) ├── public/ # Background ambient video and static assets ├── screenshots/ # MacBook Pro M4 & iPhone 16 Pro showcase mockups └── README.md ``` --- ## Getting Started & Local Development ### Prerequisites - **Node.js**: Version 18.0.0 or higher - **npm** or **pnpm** ### Installation & Setup > **Environment Variables:** No `.env` file or external API keys are required. All scroll timelines, 3D animations, and canvas scrubbing execute 100% locally in the browser. ```bash # 1. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/reactjs-airpro-template.git cd reactjs-airpro-template # 2. Install dependencies npm install # 3. Start local development server npm run dev ``` Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your web browser. ### Production Build ```bash # Compile and optimize production distribution bundle npm run build ``` --- ## Author Developed by **[Widi Firmansyah](https://widifirmaan.web.id)**.

# Tryngo > Code made easy, with in-browser playgrounds and interactive quizzes. Tryngo is an open-source, 100% client-side interactive learning platform featuring 28 structured curricula (332 weekly modules) across modern frontend, backend, database, and DevOps technologies with in-browser WebAssembly runtimes, 7,332 quiz questions, and zero login required. # Book Games > Interactive gamified educational platform and teacher gradebook built with Next.js 14 and React 18. Book Games is an educational web application built with Next.js 14 (App Router) and Cloudflare D1 (Serverless SQLite), migrated from a legacy Java desktop client. Deployed on Cloudflare Workers with OpenNext, it features 30 interactive mini-game levels across 5 psychological well-being dimensions, a student adventure progress map with achievement badges, and a teacher portal for student gradebook tracking and Excel export. ![Level 30 Scoop of Hope Mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/nextjs-book-games/main/screenshots/Level%2030%20Scoop%20of%20Hope%20Mobile.png) | --- ## Features - **30 Gamified Psychological Activities (`app/level/[id]/page.tsx`)**: Educational reflection exercises divided into 5 psychological well-being (PWB) dimensions: - **Self Acceptance (Levels 1–7)**: Word search grid (`Level1WordSearch.tsx`), multi-expression facial sketching (`Level2Drawing.tsx`), hope balloons (`Level3Games.tsx`), mirror reflection, and introspection boxes. - **Environmental Mastery (Levels 8–12)**: Anxiety elixir potion mixing (`Level8Games.tsx`), concentric circle reflection, freehand canvas drawing (`Level10Drawing.tsx`), calming soundtrack audio session, and emotional splash checkpoint. - **Personal Growth (Levels 13–24)**: Tree of hope (`Level13Games.tsx`), biggest dream declaration, cloud imagination, sticky notes action planner, and 7 sequential stages of change stairways (`Level18Games.tsx` – `Level24Games.tsx`). - **Purpose in Life (Levels 25–29)**: Self-exploration questionnaire, three-era time wheel (Dahulu, Sekarang, Esok), gratitude treasure map, goal direction compass, and letter to future self. - **Positive Relations (Level 30)**: Multi-layered ice cream scoop of hope (`Level30IceCream.tsx`) capturing wishes for loved ones and social circles. - **Sequential Adventure Progression Map (`app/dashboard/siswa/page.tsx`)**: Student dashboard displaying dynamic level completion counts, category locks/unlocks based on completed prerequisite levels, and achievement badges (`CHAPTER_1_COMPLETE` through `CHAPTER_5_COMPLETE`, and `CONSISTENT_WORKER` 7-day streak awards). - **Teacher Gradebook & Analytics (`app/dashboard/guru/page.tsx`)**: Central educator management portal with school and class filtering, student progress tables across all 30 levels with completion status checkmarks, detailed submission response inspection, and 1-click Excel spreadsheet export via SheetJS (`.xlsx`). - **Unified Role-Based Authentication (`app/login/page.tsx` & `lib/authOptions.ts`)**: Credentials authentication powered by NextAuth.js separating Teacher (`GURU`) administrative rights from Student (`SISWA`) gameplay sessions. - **Cloudflare D1 Serverless SQLite Storage (`lib/models/User.ts` & `schema.sql`)**: High-performance relational database binding (`env.DB`) executing zero-latency SQL queries with serialized level response maps, submission timestamps, and award notification queues. - **HTML5 Canvas Sketching Engine (`Level2Drawing.tsx`, `Level10Drawing.tsx`)**: Responsive drawing canvas supporting freehand pen strokes, color selection, stroke thickness adjustments, undo history, and direct data-URL base64 export. - **Interactive Word Search Arena (`Level1WordSearch.tsx`)**: 10x10 matrix word finder with real-time drag-to-select letter highlighting, horizontal/vertical word detection, and audio feedback. - **Curriculum Portfolio Showcase (`app/portfolio/page.tsx`)**: Printable A4-landscape digital curriculum overview displaying comprehensive activity modules and visual documentation. - **Legacy Desktop Modernization (`legacy-java/`)**: Complete web reimplementation preserving the curriculum, game logic, and asset structure of the original Java Swing desktop client. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technologies | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Core Framework** | Next.js `14.2.35`, React `18.2.0` | App Router, Server Components, and API Route backend endpoints | | **Database** | Cloudflare D1 (Serverless SQLite) | Serverless relational SQL database storing user profiles and level progress | | **Authentication** | NextAuth.js `4.24.5` | Role-based credential session handling and route protection | | **Spreadsheet Engine** | SheetJS (xlsx) `0.18.5` | Client-side grade report compilation and XLSX binary export | | **Styling & UI** | Tailwind CSS `3.3.0` | Accessible kid-friendly color palettes and responsive grid layouts | --- ## Project Structure ```bash / ├── app/ │ ├── level/[id]/ # Dynamic educational game routes (Levels 1-30) │ ├── dashboard/ │ │ ├── guru/ # Teacher analytics and student score tracking │ │ └── siswa/ # Student level progression adventure map │ ├── login/ # Unified role authentication portal │ ├── portfolio/ # Interactive showcase and curriculum overview │ ├── api/ # NextAuth, level scoring, user management, and seed endpoints │ ├── components/ # 30 individual LevelGame React components │ └── page.tsx # Public landing portal ├── lib/ # Database connection, D1 User model, and game curriculum data ├── legacy-java/ # Original Java Swing desktop application source ├── open-next.config.ts # OpenNext Cloudflare adapter build configuration ├── schema.sql # Cloudflare D1 SQLite database schema and seed data ├── wrangler.jsonc # Cloudflare Workers configuration with custom domain routing ├── screenshots/ # MacBook Pro M4 & iPhone 16 Pro showcase mockups └── README.md ``` --- ## Getting Started & Local Development ### Prerequisites - # Javex > Modern Bootstrap 5 e-learning template and practice quiz application inspired by Samsung OneUI design language. Javex is a responsive Bootstrap 5 template designed for interactive e-learning media and spreadsheet education, styled with custom OneUI-inspired rounded card elements and navigation primitives (`assets/css/oneui.css`). It features structured curriculum modules, competency standards alignment (Kompetensi Dasar), interactive practice drills, automated evaluation quizzes, formulas cheatsheet, video lessons, and academic bibliography pages. [![Live Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-widifirmaan.web.id%2Fjavex-10B981?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](http://widifirmaan.web.id/bootstrap-javex-template/) [![Bootstrap](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bootstrap-5-7952B3?style=flat-square&logo=bootstrap&logoColor=white)](https://getbootstrap.com/) [![Design System](https://img.shields.io/badge/Design-OneUI_Pill_Cards-01723A?style=flat-square)](#features) [![Font Awesome](https://img.shields.io/badge/Icons-Font_Awesome_5-528DD7?style=flat-square&logo=fontawesome&logoColor=white)](https://fontawesome.com/) --- ## Live Production - **URL:** [http://widifirmaan.web.id/bootstrap-javex-template/](http://widifirmaan.web.id/bootstrap-javex-template/) - **Deployment:** Apache Web Server / Cloudflare Proxy --- ## Showcase | Desktop Interface (MacBook Pro M4) | Mobile Interface (iPhone 16 Pro) | | :---: | :---: | | **Homepage Desktop**

![Daftar Pustaka Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/bootstrap-javex-template/main/screenshots/Javex%20Daftar%20Pustaka%20Desktop.png) | **Daftar Pustaka Mobile**
![Daftar Pustaka Mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/bootstrap-javex-template/main/screenshots/Javex%20Daftar%20Pustaka%20Mobile.png) | --- ## Features - **Spreadsheet Learning Modules (`pendahuluan.html`, `mulai.html`, `format.html`)**: Step-by-step Excel guides covering introductory concepts, interface elements (Ribbon tabs, Name Box, Formula Bar), workbook formatting, and data types with smooth horizontal pill tab navigation. - **Formulas & Functions Cheatsheet (`rumus.html`)**: Reference catalog with syntax rules and practical examples for arithmetic formulas, SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN, COUNT, and logical IF statements. - **Hands-On Practical Worksheets (`latsoal.html`, `mulailatsoal.html`)**: Case study exercises with spreadsheet sample tables and an external Google Forms submission workflow. - **Evaluation Examination (`quiz.html`, `mulaiquiz.html`)**: 20-question multiple-choice assessment with client-side JavaScript scoring, completion validation, pass/fail threshold evaluation (>= 70%), and a Bootstrap 5 modal result popup. - **Embedded Video Tutorial (`video.html`)**: Responsive 16:9 Bootstrap ratio container with an embedded YouTube spreadsheet tutorial video. - **Curriculum Standards Alignment (`kd.html`)**: Indonesian vocational curriculum Kompetensi Dasar (KD 3.4 & 4.4) and competency achievement indicators (IPK). - **OneUI-Inspired Design System (`assets/css/oneui.css`)**: Card-based interface styled with Samsung OneUI rounded corners (`border-radius: 24px`), pill tab navigation, mobile bottom navigation bar, and CSS custom properties. - **Audio Narration Player (`index.html`)**: Embedded HTML5 audio player (`audio.mp3`) providing introductory background audio on the welcome portal. - **Academic Bibliography & Developer Profile (`daftarpustaka.html`, `profilpengembang.html`)**: Textbook citation modals and academic development team profile. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technologies | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **UI Framework** | Bootstrap `5.0.0-beta2` | Responsive layout grid, tabbed pill navigation, responsive 16:9 ratio, and modals | | **JavaScript Library** | jQuery `3.3.1` | DOM manipulation and legacy script support (`vendor/jquery/jquery.min.js`) | | **Custom Styling** | OneUI CSS (`assets/css/oneui.css`) | Samsung OneUI-inspired design system, floating pill navbar, and CSS variables | | **Typography** | Poppins Font | Modern sans-serif typography (300, 400, 500, 600, 700) via Google Fonts | | **Iconography** | Font Awesome `5.15.3` | Vector icons for subject categories and navigation controls via CDNJS | | **Interactivity** | Vanilla JavaScript | Quiz answer validation, automatic score tallying, and pass/fail modal triggering | | **Multimedia** | HTML5 Audio & YouTube Iframe | Homepage audio player (`audio.mp3`) and embedded responsive tutorial video | --- ## Project Structure ```bash / ├── index.html # Main entrance portal with category cards and audio player ├── kd.html # Basic competencies (KD 3.4 & 4.4) and indicators (IPK) ├── materi.html # Excel learning curriculum syllabus cards ├── pendahuluan.html # Introductory concepts and Excel advantages ├── mulai.html # Interface elements, ribbon tabs, and menu commands guide ├── format.html # Workbook formatting guide with pill tabs ├── rumus.html # Formulas & functions cheat sheet (SUM, IF, AVERAGE) ├── latsoal.html # Practice exercises instruction entrance ├── mulailatsoal.html # Hands-on practice worksheet with Google Form submit link ├── quiz.html # Final examination instruction entrance ├── mulaiquiz.html # 20-question quiz engine with automatic scoring and modal ├── video.html # Responsive 16:9 YouTube video tutorial player ├── daftarpustaka.html # Academic textbook references and modal descriptions ├── profilpengembang.html # Developer author and academic advisor profiles ├── audio.mp3 # Background audio narration for the welcome page ├── assets/ │ ├── css/oneui.css # Custom OneUI design tokens and navigation styles │ └── dafpust.png # Academic reference illustration ├── daftarpustaka/ # Textbook cover thumbnail assets ├── vendor/ │ ├── bootstrap/ # Bootstrap 5.0.0-beta2 CSS and JS bundle │ └── jquery/ # jQuery 3.3.1 library ├── raw_screenshots/ # Source captures with notch offset ├── screenshots/ # MacBook Pro M4 & iPhone 16 Pro showcase mockups └── README.md ``` --- ## Getting Started & Local Development ### Prerequisites Static HTML/CSS/JS application. No compilers, Node modules, or package managers required. ### Local Development > **Environment Variables:** No `.env` file or API keys are required. All interactive quizzes, scoring timers, and multimedia elements execute 100% locally in the browser. ```bash # 1. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/bootstrap-javex-template.git cd bootstrap-javex-template # 2. Start local static server python3 -m http.server 8000 # or using Node.js: npx serve . ``` Open [http://localhost:8000](http://localhost:8000) in your web browser. --- ## Author Developed by **[Widi Firmansyah](https://widifirmaan.web.id)**.
